x-provenance.basis: Capabilities realized in #49 and judged in the re-homing note; the requirements state them as properties of the delivered things so they survive the closed pull request. They extend, and do not replace, ai-assisted-indoor-grow-controller.

board-opening.need: The capabilities of the closed home-grow pull request are held as requirements on the indoor-grow controller, the cannabis-sourcing finder and the Group's MAPE-K engine, so that a future realization composes the engine instead of building a parallel loop.

requirements.says: The indoor-grow controller shall refuse any proposal that would exceed a jurisdiction's living-plant, flowering-plant or possession limit, reading the limits from a jurisdiction record and carrying the cited rule in each refusal.
requirements.rationale: #49 minnesota-governor.mjs: refuses adding a plant, flipping, or shortening a non-flowering room's photoperiod to <= 13 h past a cap; refuses a harvest past possession; every refusal carries the statute.

requirements.says: Where the jurisdiction record requires an enclosed, locked space, the indoor-grow controller shall refuse light, irrigation, nutrient, pH and CO2 actuation until an attestation of that space is journaled.

The indoor-grow controller shall never light a flowering room during its dark period, guarded at the plan, at execution, at the home-automation hub, in node firmware that runs the photoperiod from its own clock after ten minutes without the hub, and by a mechanical timer in series with each light.
requirements.rationale: #49 deploy/README 'Light clock failsafe': four layers; a dark-period light leak can cost a crop.

requirements.says: The indoor-grow controller shall schedule irrigation by crop steering, in P1 ramp, P2 maintenance and P3 dryback phases with a vegetative or generative strategy per room stage, taking peak, floor and dryback targets from the cultivation research record.

The indoor-grow controller shall keep a twin per plant holding canopy cover and height, days in stage, growing degree-days, daily light integral, intercepted light, crop water stress index, predicted dry yield and predicted harvest date, updating each cultivar's yield constant from every journaled harvest.
requirements.rationale: #49 src/twin/plant-twin.mjs; prior N(0.12, 0.04^2) g/mol from Rodriguez-Morrison 2021.

requirements.says: When at least three harvests are journaled, the indoor-grow controller shall propose the next environment recipe by Bayesian optimization inside the hard safety bounds and the flowering bands, stating the expected improvement and the number of observations in each proposal.
requirements.rationale: #49 src/optimize/recipe-optimizer.mjs: Gaussian process, expected improvement, Thompson sampling for the next cultivar.

requirements.says: The indoor-grow controller shall withhold any start or flip whose harvest would carry the residence's projected stock (harvests less cure loss, gifts and use, projected daily) past the jurisdiction's possession limit, queuing a task with the earliest date that fits.
The indoor-grow controller shall derive canopy cover, growth, trichome maturity, pest signs and dark-period light leaks from camera frames and journal each as an observation.
requirements.rationale: #49 src/perception: canopy, color, growth, light-leak, pests, trichomes.

requirements.says: The indoor-grow controller shall hold its state as a fold of an append-only journal of readings, plans, actuations, proposals, refusals, harvests, gifts, quality scores and tasks, so that state loaded from the journal equals the state the loop held.

The indoor-grow controller shall read sensors and command devices only through an adapter boundary (home-automation, device-node and simulated adapters) that defaults to a dry run journaling actuations without sending them.
The indoor-grow controller shall send only changed commands, except for a re-send of its last commands every two hours.
requirements.rationale: #49 deploy/README: a rebooted node comes up with relays off.

requirements.says: The indoor-grow controller shall raise an alarm once per fault per hour, and announce its clearing, for readings older than fifteen minutes, an unreachable hub, a reading outside the hard safety bounds, a silent sensor, a failed job and a compliance violation.
While the home-automation hub is unreachable, the indoor-grow controller shall command no device.
requirements.rationale: #49 deploy/README: no device is left changed by the failure itself.

requirements.says: The indoor-grow controller shall take stage setpoints, cultivar records, jurisdiction limits, device maps and camera maps only as records named at configuration, never as literals in its source.

The indoor-grow controller shall enter every advisor output into the loop as a proposal, from an offline advisor daily and, where an inference credential is configured in the environment, from an online advisor weekly over the journal and the latest frames.

The cannabis-sourcing finder shall fetch a menu platform automatically only when the platform terms record states its automated access as exactly "permitted", parsing otherwise only the pages and exports the operator saved.

The cannabis-sourcing finder shall fetch a dispensary's own site only where its robots.txt allows, identify itself with a contact in its user agent, wait at least ten seconds between requests to a host, and cache each source for six hours.

The cannabis-sourcing finder shall rank offers by an explained weighted score over THC band, CBD:THC ratio, terpene profile, strain name, price and distance, under hard filters on category, price per gram, distance and opening hours.
The cannabis-sourcing finder shall filter seeds and clones by seed type, flowering days, stretch and mold resistance, flagging each clone that carries no hop latent viroid test claim.
The cannabis-sourcing finder shall keep the user's home coordinates on the user's machine.
The Group's MAPE-K engine shall hold each loop's knowledge as an append-only journal whose fold is the loop's state.
requirements.rationale: Carried from #49; no MAPE-K engine package exists in the house on 2026-10-10 (see the re-homing note).

requirements.says: The Group's MAPE-K engine shall admit every agent output as a proposal with its evidence, decide it by admit, queue or refuse, and journal the proposal with the decision and its reason.
requirements.rationale: #49 plan.mjs proposals; existing requirement ai-assisted-indoor-grow-controller R4.

requirements.says: The Group's MAPE-K engine shall pass every plan and every proposal through governors supplied as records before execution.
requirements.rationale: #49 compliance governor as a pure check before execute.

requirements.says: The Group's MAPE-K engine shall execute only through effector adapters, change-only, with a dry-run mode.
The Group's MAPE-K engine shall hold hard safety bounds that no admitted proposal can widen.
The Group's MAPE-K engine shall run a loop on a cadence with a heartbeat, a watchdog and fault alarms.
